title: WorkstreamRegistrationResult
description: Closed v1 portable result envelope for the Workstream Registration protocol (U3, PLAN:381-392). The stable result document every registration, linking, unregister, resolution, and inspection operation emits (CLI --json, PLAN:475). Readers dispatch on the required integer `version` before applying this closed schema (KTD3, PLAN:188); v1 allows the value 1. The envelope separates protocol outcome, marker validity, write/read-back/link effects, verified identity, per-record-source capability status, and structured diagnostics (PLAN:389). Outcome names are frozen at PLAN:391/PLAN:556: there is deliberately no `invalid-marker` outcome - malformed-marker inspection reports `occupied-invalid` (PLAN:556; CONCEPTS.md:62). `conflict` is the projection write-time conflict outcome (PLAN:463, 528, 556). Invalid or unsupported markers cannot promote claimed values to authority: verified identity requires a valid-class marker with a verified read-back (PLAN:389). The envelope carries no URI content, no record-source URI, no native validator messages, no instance values, no property names, and no secrets; diagnostics carry only phase, stable code, bounded safe path, count, and bounded operator-facing label and affected local path (KTD12, PLAN:197). Bounded everywhere: every string has a maxLength cap, every array a maxItems cap, and `additionalProperties: false` at every object level.

version.description: Result contract version; readers dispatch on it before applying the closed schema (KTD3, PLAN:188). v1 allowed value: 1.

outcome.description: Protocol outcome name, frozen at PLAN:391/PLAN:556. Every name is a state in the registration-protocol.md machine-readable state table (REV:67); there is no `invalid-marker` outcome (PLAN:556; CONCEPTS.md:62).

validity.description: Marker validity, aligned with the U5 manifest vocabulary (valid / valid-with-warnings / invalid) plus not-applicable where no marker claim applies or the marker state is unknown (no marker, marker gone, or write unverified). valid-with-warnings is distinct from failure (PLAN:349, 351). Invalid markers never promote claimed values to authority (PLAN:389).

effects.description: Structural write/read-back/link effects (PLAN:389). Expresses partial success: written-unverified (marker_written with read_back_verified false), registered-unlinked (read_back_verified with linked false), invalid-deleted-unverified (marker_deleted with absence_verified false).

identity.description: Verified marker identity (RFC 4122 v4 lowercase UUID, same shape as the marker contract). Structurally incapable of carrying URI content: fixed 36-char lowercase UUID pattern only. Present only when verified (if/then below): a valid-class marker whose read-back verified. Never regenerated (R14, PLAN:118; PLAN:451).

capabilities.description: Per-record-source capability status (PLAN:305): distinguishes not-checked, unsupported, and inaccessible states; no dereference is ever performed and no URI content appears (KTD5, PLAN:190; AE9, PLAN:134). References record sources by 0-based index into the marker's record_sources array, never by URI. Absent = no capability claim (all not-checked).

diagnostics.description: Bounded structured diagnostics (KTD12, PLAN:197). Native validator messages and parameters may embed instance values, property names, URI content, secrets, or snippets and are never emitted; diagnostics carry only phase, stable code, bounded safe path, count, and bounded label and affected local path under length caps. No free-text URI field exists.

warnings.description: Structured warnings accompanying a valid-with-warnings outcome (e.g., a non-dereferenceable record source, AE9 PLAN:134; PLAN:391). Closed-token shaped: lowercase alphanumeric tokens with hyphens, bounded to 64 characters, structurally incapable of carrying URI content, instance values, or secrets.

allOf.description: Verified identity only when the marker is valid-class and its read-back verified (PLAN:389): invalid or unsupported markers cannot promote claimed values to authority.
An invalid marker can never report a verified read-back.
registered: write, read-back verified, projection linked (AE1, PLAN:126; protocol 4.6).
linked-existing: supported valid marker read unchanged; no write, no confirmation, identity never regenerated (KTD7, PLAN:192; AE2, PLAN:127; protocol 4.7).
cancelled: no marker write, no delete, no projection change (F4, PLAN:83; AE4, PLAN:129; protocol 4.8).
stopped: operational no-write stop, bounded diagnostic, no draft (F5, PLAN:84; PLAN:200; protocol 4.9).

written-unverified: marker write succeeded but read-back verification failed; identity never regenerated; the marker may exist and be valid but the implementation cannot claim it (PLAN:452; KTD13 PLAN:198; protocol 4.10).
registered-unlinked: marker written and read-back verified, but the projection/link update failed; the marker remains authoritative (AE7, PLAN:132; protocol 4.11).
unregistered: confirmed conditional delete with absence read-back verified; the marker is gone (AE8, PLAN:133; KTD10 PLAN:195; protocol 4.12).

occupied-invalid: a marker at the marker path is invalid, partial (interrupted write), or unsupported-version; it is never overwritten; covers every invalid marker - there is no separate invalid-marker outcome (KTD13 PLAN:198; PLAN:556; CONCEPTS.md:62; protocol 4.13).
invalid-marker-resolved: confirmed resolution delete with absence read-back verified; the path is free for a new registration (PLAN:451; protocol 4.14).
invalid-deleted-unverified: resolution delete succeeded but absence read-back failed; the marker may or may not be absent; nothing is rewritten; recovery is re-inspection (PLAN:451; protocol 4.15).

changed-marker-stopped: cooperation could not be established or a changed marker, target, or identity was observed at any re-read; no delete, marker untouched (KTD10 PLAN:195; PLAN:463; protocol 4.16).

conflict: projection write-time conflict - the captured target already holds a different identity; the marker is unchanged and remains authoritative, the projection does not link it; the only in-scope duplicate signal (PLAN:528, 542, 556; protocol 4.17).

marker_written.description: The marker was created/written by this operation (exclusive-create, never silent replace, R4 PLAN:96).

marker_deleted.description: The marker was deleted by this operation (confirmed conditional delete, KTD10 PLAN:195). A single operation never both writes and deletes.

read_back_verified.description: The marker was read back (or read, for linking) and passed raw-guard + schema validation with exact identity verification (KTD13 PLAN:198).

absence_verified.description: Absence read-back verified the marker is gone after a delete (AE8 PLAN:133; PLAN:451).

linked.description: The local projection/link update succeeded (AE7 PLAN:132).

projection.description: Projection state, matching the transition fixture inputs vocabulary (protocol section 14): linked = projection updated; unlinked = marker authoritative but link failed; conflict = write-time conflict on a captured target; none = no projection operation.

source_index.description: 0-based index into the marker's record_sources array (1-32 entries, workstream.schema.json); capability is reported per record source, never by URI content (PLAN:307).

status.description: Capability status per record source (PLAN:305): not-checked = no capability claim; unsupported = accepted provider without dereference support; inaccessible = the source cannot be reached on this device. No dereference is ever performed and no URI content is carried (KTD5 PLAN:190; AE9 PLAN:134).

code.description: Optional stable capability code; a closed enum, never free text.

count.description: Number of diagnostics; bounded to the items cap (KTD12 PLAN:197). The runner asserts count == items length.

items.description: Bounded diagnostic list. Native validator messages, instance values, property names, URI content, and secrets are never emitted (KTD12 PLAN:197).

phase.description: Diagnostic phase. The first seven match the raw-guard termination phases (KTD11 PLAN:196; expectations.schema.json); the remaining five cover write, read-back, link, projection, and general operational failures (KTD12 PLAN:197).

code.description: Stable diagnostic code (KTD12 PLAN:197). Closed v1 enum: raw-guard and schema codes, operational stop/partial codes, and the safe internal-failure code (PLAN:556 exit 6). No free-text code field.

safe_path.description: Bounded safe path (KTD12 PLAN:197): a fixed, implementation-defined reference such as the marker path; printable ASCII, at most 256 characters. Not a URI field; never carries record-source URI content.

label.description: Operator-facing label under length caps (KTD12 PLAN:197; KTD9 PLAN:194); mirrors the marker label bound. A label is data, not an instruction.

affected_local_path.description: Affected device-local path under a length cap (KTD12 PLAN:197; KTD4 PLAN:189). Local routing state only, never an authority reference; printable ASCII, at most 1024 characters.
